text:
maria: Reporting a spike of 502s for hosted API from customer acme-prod since 09:30 UTC. Endpoints: /v1/embeddings, /v1/generate. Sample curl returns 502 after ~4s. request id in payload: 7c3a...

alex: Any traces? can someone grab edge logs + trace id?

sre-bot: New deploy at 09:25 UTC (edge-proxy v2.14.0) — no auto-rollback.

jordan: I have a trace id from ACME request: trace-8a9f. forwarding to eng-sre.

sam: Reproduced locally with small curl payload? i tried streaming embed -> 502 after header ack.

lee: saw repeated upstream "RST_STREAM" in envoy logs tied to auth-proxy timeouts. possibly backpressure.

maria: customer also reported billing header increased in size after token rotation, sending large 'x-billing-meta' header.

alex: can we get full curl sample?

maria: ```curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' -H 'x-billing-meta: long-string...' -d @payload.json```

jordan: throwing into replay infra now.

sam: quick mitigation: temporarily strip x-billing-meta at edge to see if it clears. willing to try canary.

lee: stripping header via ingress route config would be quick, but need approval if this touches customer metadata. it's metadata only but want signoff.

alex: I see auth-proxy returns 429 to edge, and edge translates to 502 because stream resets mid-body. billing service is rate-limiting after token swap.

maria: customer confirms they rotated billing tokens ~09:20, started sending bigger header payload.

sam: hypothesis: big header + auth-proxy backpressure -> envoy h2 window exhaustion -> RST_STREAM -> 502s.

jordan: replay confirms increasing header length reproduces the 502 pattern.

sre-bot: alerting on v2.14.0 h2 window defaults.

lee: we can patch edge to tolerate larger header size and add spike-backoff on auth-proxy calls. patch prepared.

alex: recommended customer workaround: remove x-billing-meta or reduce size, and fall back to dedicated endpoint if urgent.

maria: customer applied header-trim and saw immediate improvement. 502 rate dropped to normal.

deploy-bot: edge-proxy hotfix v2.14.1 built and staged for canary.

jordan: next steps: push hotfix, monitor for regressions, add telemetry for header size vs 502 rate, update KB for billing header limits.

maria: thanks all, I'll update the acme support ticket and include repro + mitigation steps. :thumbsup:
